name: copilot-mem
description: Persistent memory for GitHub Copilot in VS Code - persist context across agent sessions

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory and context compression across coding sessions.
interface.longDescription: copilot-mem captures coding-session activity, compresses it into reusable observations, and injects relevant context back into future GitHub Copilot agent sessions in VS Code.
defaultPrompt: Find what I already learned about this codebase before I start a new task.
Show recent observations related to the files I am editing right now.
Summarize the last session and inject the most relevant context into this one.
